description: This file contains functions for handling ANSI escape sequences, extracting URLs from markdown text, and applying OSC 8 terminal hyperlinks to text lines, primarily for rendering hyperlinks in terminal interfaces.

methods.name: wrapOsc8
methods.description: Wraps a given text with OSC 8 escape sequences to create a terminal hyperlink.

methods.name: extractUrls
methods.description: Extracts all unique URLs from markdown text, including bare URLs and markdown links.

methods.name: addOsc8Hyperlinks
methods.description: Adds OSC 8 hyperlinks to lines of text based on a list of URLs, handling URL splits across lines.
